tagline: Fast, modern Ukrainian open-source Minecraft launcher (MIT) with Modrinth & CurseForge support.
description: GileaLauncher by TensaCraft is a fast, modern open-source (MIT) Minecraft launcher for Windows, Linux, and macOS supporting Modrinth and CurseForge modpacks and mods, Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt, plus Microsoft and offline accounts.
features: Fast modern UI for Windows, Linux, and macOS
Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, and Quilt support
